\begin{tikzpicture}[
  node distance=8mm,
  startstop/.style={rectangle, rounded corners, fill=blue!20, draw},
  process/.style={rectangle, draw, fill=orange!20},
  decision/.style={diamond, aspect=2, draw, fill=green!20},
  arrow/.style={-{Stealth[length=3mm]}, thick}]

\node[startstop] (start) {开始};
\node[process, below=of start] (read) {读取数据};
\node[decision, below=of read] (cond) {数据有效吗};
\node[process, below left=12mm and 8mm of cond] (yes) {处理数据};
\node[process, below right=12mm and 8mm of cond] (no) {报错};
\node[startstop, below=20mm of cond] (end) {结束};

\draw[arrow] (start) -- (read);
\draw[arrow] (read) -- (cond);
\draw[arrow] (cond) -| node[above,pos=0.75] {是} (yes);
\draw[arrow] (cond) -| node[above,pos=0.75] {否} (no);
\draw[arrow] (yes) |- (end);
\draw[arrow] (no)  |- (end);
\end{tikzpicture}
